scope: One current B2 natural Part-1 start, first enemy release, and bounded 128-IRQ observation. Evidence preparation only; no production or ticket-status change.

nest_owned_background_valid_zero.mismatches: 4412-4423; all records have direction North, cell row 11 or 12, pointer within the 16x32 nest, and background_valid=0. Preserve the raw results; do not count these as roaming-actor pose samples. compose_enemy_zone draws active nest records before the dormant sprite, so this is a structural release/overlap state.

source_qualified_roaming.lifecycle_condition: slot 0 active and saved_background_valid=1, the source-published roaming-underlay state
source_qualified_roaming.direction_metadata: Read from the published record; North through cell-arrival transition, then West. Part-1 family 0 template selection uses the record direction and shared ENEMY_ANIM.

slot0_part1_enemy.run_range_note: The initial transition run and final capture-end run are clipped. This is a measured range, not a fixed 8-IRQ acceptance rule.

dormant_den.run_range_note: The initial eligibility boundary and final capture-end run are clipped; no strict raw-IRQ dwell threshold is applied.

logical_clock.interpretation: Stable dispatcher endpoints link exact published Part-1 roaming and dormant-den templates to the shared enemy animation phase. Raw Vbord holds vary with publication timing and are not equivalent to logical dwell.

source_qualification.enemy_release: enemy_release_impl initializes slot 0 at ENEMY_FB=$57EC, cell (12,12), direction North, with saved-background-valid clear.
source_qualification.nest_and_roaming_ownership: compose_enemy_zone draws active nest actors in rows 11/12, then draws the dormant sprite. actor_closure_draw/roam_finish_shadow establishes saved-background ownership as an actor is staged into roaming. The retained trace has all 12 no-match frames in the nest-owned state and all 113 background-valid roaming frames exact-matching.
source_qualification.sprite_selection: Part-1 enemy_frame_number indexes family 0 by published record direction and ENEMY_ANIM; record byte 3 is movement substep and is not used as animation phase.
source_qualification.limits: The trace preserves hashes and per-sample metadata but not raw FRONT framebuffer bytes. The 12 nest-owned no-match observations are retained and classified by source lifecycle/occlusion; no separate pixel-layer reconstruction is claimed. No movement-equivalence result is claimed.

disposition: No ordinary enemy/den timer mismatch is established by this bounded sample. Current roaming samples are exact and link to the source-defined 8-logical-tick phase. The sampled logical period does not justify a timer repair. BUG-080 movement equivalence and separate presentation owners remain outside this sample.

retained_artifact.note: Hash field should be checked against the exact retained bytes before commit.
